title: Reconfidencing LLM Uncertainty from the Grouping Loss Perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating calibration curves and grouping loss of LLM confidence scores by partitioning query entities based on their popularity (measured by Wikipedia backlink counts) to compare performance between well-known and long-tail entities.
Comparing confidence calibration errors and grouping loss across distinct nationality sub-groups (e.g., American, French, Indian, Chinese) to measure heterogeneous overconfidence in LLM outputs.
Assessing and comparing confidence calibrations and grouping loss on the 'Birth_Place' relation dataset explicitly divided into male and female sub-groups.
